name: shadow
description: The LIVE-MIRROR SERVICE (W065): the mirror composition contract as typed DATA — real observations IN (carried verbatim, proven through the W065 broker adapter's own observation validation + composed through W050's own buildPointInTimeQuery/sealView gates), simulated positions/execution state as composed records (every position derived deterministically from the carried order+fill+observation chain — A6: no invented prices, the fill's price IS the observation's carried price), NEVER live execution (A13/A14: the service composes PROJECTION records — it does not transmit anything; there is no network code at all). The point-in-time law: every observation's availability respects W050's point-in-time firewall — an observation is invisible to a mirror session before its availableAt, and the session's cutoff IS the sealed view's cutoff (R016). Every auditable step emits W061 audit vocabulary events (typed, through packages/observability's own contracts) and the session trail is assembled + verifiable through services/operations' own trail laws. The isolation law: mirror sessions are tenant-scoped (R056 structural — session ids weigh the tenant FIRST; cross-tenant reads are loud typed refusals).
